name: A Troubled Spirit
label: Quest
description: A Troubled Spirit: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In the Blasted Lands, there is a troubled spirit who was once a great hero of the horde. A warrior's honor does not die with the body, and it would serve you well to speak with him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did Stoley cough up my booze?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you have come to alleviate my pain. I wish you could simply strike me down, but it is not that simple...
